title: Garden and Crown
author: E. M. Nakamura
blurb: Lior Underhill, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
